title: GenAI eval aggregate metrics must carry the managed dataset for logged-model dataset_name/digest
answers: genai evaluate logged model metrics missing dataset name and digest
mlflow.genai.evaluate model_id metrics not linked to evaluation dataset
eval metric on logged model shows null dataset_name dataset_digest
why does model metric not record which dataset it was computed on
body:
Symptom: When `mlflow.genai.evaluate(data=<managed EvaluationDataset>, model_id=...)` runs, the aggregate scorer metrics on the logged model (e.g. `<scorer>/mean`) show no dataset name or digest, unlike an explicit `mlflow.log_metrics(..., dataset=dataset)` call.
Root cause: mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:run computed `aggregated_metrics` and called `mlflow.log_metrics(aggregated_metrics)` without any dataset, so the managed dataset never reached the metric logger.
Fix pattern: Accept the dataset as a parameter on the harness `run` and pass it into `mlflow.log_metrics(..., dataset=dataset)`. The caller in mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py:_run_harness supplies it only when `is_managed_dataset` is true.
Constraints: Keep the gating in `_run_harness`: pass `None` for plain list/DataFrame inputs so their metric logging behavior is unchanged. Any new code path that calls `harness.run` for a managed dataset must forward the dataset too, or the metrics silently lose the dataset link.
applies: Applies to GenAI evaluation (mlflow/genai/evaluation) metric logging when a managed EvaluationDataset is passed together with model_id; not to non-GenAI evaluation.
says: Evaluation metrics logged on the model do not display the evaluation dataset name.
Aggregate evaluation scores on the registered model show null dataset digest information.
Link GenAI model evaluation metrics back to the managed dataset they were computed on.
The model metrics screen fails to record which evaluation dataset produced the scores.
search: GenAI evaluation aggregate metrics must forward the managed EvaluationDataset to mlflow.log_metrics to link logged-model metrics with dataset_name and dataset_digest. In mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:run, aggregated_metrics logging accepts dataset and forwards it to mlflow.log_metrics(..., dataset=dataset). The caller in mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py:_run_harness passes dataset only when is_managed_dataset is true, passing None for plain list and DataFrame inputs. This applies to GenAI evaluation when evaluating a managed EvaluationDataset with model_id, but not to non-GenAI evaluation.
